question: Does changing the Chinese training task mixture improve semantic and short-answer outcomes while preserving visual grounding and text ability?

training.freeze: projector + LM first and last layers; vision remains frozen
training.optimizer: AdamW fused, cosine to 10% start lr, clip 1
training.causal_intervention: Same source photos and rendered JPEG bytes in the same sorted order. Mixed ordinary mostly-object QAs versus same photos with more count and position QAs. Answers concise in both. Test measures task-mixture intervention bundled across both tasks, no per-factor causal claim.

smoke.gate: Teacher-forced exact sequence >=24/32 and answer NLL at most half of before; safe plumbing smoke, not a held-out score.

eval.decode: FP32 deterministic greedy. Generate once up to 384 and evaluate prefix through 192 (same deterministic decode sequence). Main acceptance is fixed at 192.
eval.swap: Swap with different answer on the exact same question. Reindex already generated predictions for identical (question, image) inputs; hash validated.
eval.metrics: semantic structured aliases + blind spot-check, normalized EM, short compliance independent of correctness (one direct candidate phrase of at most 12 characters), both images correct, original vs swapped original-target and no-image, repetitions, contradictions and potential hallucinations
eval.text: 100 fixed 3-way Chinese text probes, full candidate average log-likelihood (not greedy); separate report by category and gold NLL.
eval.semantic_scope: Deterministic constrained-response parser for annotation-derived captions. Long/ambiguous responses may have unrecognized semantics. A blinded audit will record misparses separately.
eval.bootstrap: 2000 paired draws over complete two-image pairs, seed 1726.

gates.image_gain_definition: targeted both-images-correct minus control both-images-correct, by image pair. Also report original minus swapped score at original targets.
gates.second_seed: Run seed 123 independent continuation iff seed 42 passes all gates.
